summary: Milestone 2026.05.225 recorded zero experiment activity; the conductor loop did not advance past activation. This is the third consecutive empty milestone (.223, .224, .225), each blocked by a missing pre-staged roadmap at handoff time. Both RTX 3090 GPUs were idle at 0% utilization throughout.
bottlenecks_identified: No research-roadmap-next.yaml was pre-staged for .225, causing conductor to stall at the archive/activation step (blocked_roadmap_missing pattern, same as .223 and .224).
Recurring empty-milestone chain: three milestones in a row produced zero experiment output, compounding research velocity loss.
improvements_suggested: Pre-stage research-roadmap-next.yaml for .226 BEFORE archiving .225 — this is the direct fix per the Pre-Staged Roadmap Convention in CLAUDE.md.
Add a conductor-level guard that warns if the current milestone closes without a pre-staged roadmap already committed for the next milestone.
Review ops/known-issues.md MANDATORY-NEXT-MILESTONE PRIORITIES for any entries pending 3+ consecutive milestones; the overdue-priority forcing function requires at least one pickup.
GPU Monitor's DualGPURunner suggestion is a false signal when both GPUs are idle due to zero experiment activation — filter this suggestion when experiments_completed=0.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Write and commit research-roadmap-next.yaml for milestone .226 immediately to break the empty-milestone chain; this is the single highest-leverage action available.
Audit the conductor's archive/activation sequence for .225 to confirm the exact failure point and determine if a structural code fix is needed alongside the roadmap pre-stage.
Scan ops/known-issues.md for overdue MANDATORY-NEXT-MILESTONE entries (pending 3+ milestones per CLAUDE.md overdue-priority forcing function) and fold them into the .226 roadmap draft.
meta_reflection: Three consecutive milestones (.223, .224, .225) completed zero experiments due to the same root cause: no pre-staged roadmap at handoff time. The Pre-Staged Roadmap Convention in CLAUDE.md exists precisely to prevent this pattern, but it requires the outer loop to act on it before archiving. Until roadmap pre-staging becomes a mechanical gate (not just a documented discipline), the empty-milestone chain will recur whenever the outer loop exits without committing the next roadmap.
